correctness.rationale: The edge inequalities suffice for the graph metric. Anchored potentials to increments is a triangular determinant-one transformation; alternating signs give the path band constraints. As an independent derivation of the series, partition the band polytope by signs and write x_i=u_i or u_i-1 with u_i in [0,1]. Same-sign edges impose no condition, and opposite-sign edges impose alternating comparisons in each maximal alternating sign block. A block of k coordinates has volume E_k/k!, with E_k the Euler zigzag number. Each composition of n-1 into those block sizes arises from exactly two sign words. The classical sec(z)+tan(z) exponential series therefore gives 2(sec(z)+tan(z)-1)/(z(2-sec(z)-tan(z))), the stated half-angle formula. The cotangent difference gives the absolutely convergent lattice coefficients; bounding the nonleading sum by (2π-θ)^(2-n) times the sum of inverse squared nonleading pole locations proves the uniform error. n=2 gives a length-two segment. Independent exact enumeration by fractional-coordinate order reproduces the listed five volumes and extends the finite test through dimension eight. The word 'positive' should be read as positivity-preserving, not as asserting a positive-semidefinite transfer operator; no such spectral assertion is needed.
residual_risks: The replay is finite; the composition and cotangent arguments are the all-dimensional checks.
